topics.title_zh: 特斯拉Cybercab强制299美元月费引发所有权争议
topics.title_en: Tesla's Mandatory $299/mo Cybercab Subscription Sparks Ownership Revolt
topics.summary_zh: 特斯拉向个人买家开启Cybercab预订，除2.99万美元车价外，强制捆绑每月299美元自动驾驶运营订阅费，且对运营权施加严格地理围栏限制。此举引发了关于“硬件所有权”与“软件服务强制租赁”之间界限的激烈行业辩论。
topics.summary_en: Tesla has opened Cybercab orders for personal users, requiring a $29,990 purchase price plus a mandatory $299/month 'Autonomy Subscription.' The inclusion of strict geofencing and operational limitations on purchased vehicles has triggered intense industry debate over the erosion of true hardware ownership versus mandatory software service taxation.

perspective_pro.role_zh: 🟢 演进派 / 特斯拉支持者
perspective_pro.speaker_zh: 特斯拉车主社区与马斯克信徒
perspective_pro.speaker_en: Tesla owner community and Musk proponents
perspective_pro.point_zh: 认为自动驾驶本质是高带宽、需云端持续更新的实时AI服务，订阅制是摊薄高昂研发与算力成本、确保安全合规的最佳路径。
perspective_pro.point_en: Argues that autonomous driving is a real-time AI service requiring constant cloud updates, making a subscription model the only sustainable path to recoup heavy R&D costs and ensure safety compliance.

perspective_con.role_zh: 🔴 工业理性派 / 消费者维权者
perspective_con.speaker_zh: 传统汽车工程专家与隐私监管者
perspective_con.speaker_en: Traditional automotive engineers and privacy regulators
perspective_con.point_zh: 批评这是将“订阅软件”强加于硬件资产的掠夺性行为，不仅剥夺了用户的完全处置权，更通过地理围栏建立了变相的厂商私有领地。
perspective_con.point_en: Criticizes the move as predatory 'software-locking' of physical assets, stripping users of full disposal rights and effectively establishing a proprietary corporate fiefdom via geofencing.

linked_news.title_zh: 特斯拉发布Cybercab订阅协议，强制收取每月299美元软件费
linked_news.title_en: Tesla posts its Cybercab Autonomy Subscription Agreement, requiring personal buyers to pay a mandatory $299/month on top of the vehicle's $29,990 purchase price (Fred Lambert/Electrek)
Tesla says "select customers" can now place orders for its Cybercab "for personal use", for $30K plus a required $299/month Autonomy Subscription to operate (Kara Carlson/Bloomberg)

linked_tweets.author: JayDsmart
linked_tweets.content_zh:
埃隆，这不是一键就能轻松完成的

付费用户正在实时观看 Grok Bot 的崩溃。即使使用最高的订阅计划，人们在限制重置之前几天就会耗尽使用量

与此同时，机器人每天都变得越来越慢、越来越不智能、越来越不可靠。过去工作完美的事情现在失败了，给出了错误的答案，或者陷入了困境

人们在正常甚至较轻的工作负载下达到 100% 使用率，使得该产品在一周结束之前几乎毫无用处。

您的团队几乎没有提及这些严重的使用和质量问题

Grok Bot 应该是一个可以处理实际工作的人工智能代理。但现在，它在那些相信你的承诺的人面前分崩离析

站起来。修复使用限制，恢复用户最初付费的品质
linked_tweets.content_en:
Elon this is not one-click-easy

Paying users are watching Grok Bot fall apart in real time. People are running out of usage days before their limits reset, even on the highest subscription plans

At the same time, the bots are becoming slower, less intelligent, and less reliable every day. Things that used to work perfectly now fail, give wrong answers, or get stuck

 People are hitting 100% usage with normal or even lighter workloads, making the product almost useless before the week is over.

Your team has said almost nothing about these serious usage and quality problems

Grok Bot is supposed to be an AI agent that can handle real work. But right now, it's falling apart in front of the very people who trusted your promises

Step up. Fix the usage limits and restore the quality users originally paid for

topics.title_zh: 英伟达董事会启动黄仁勋外国情报渗透审查
topics.title_en: Nvidia Board Launches Intelligence Probe into Jensen Huang's Ties
topics.summary_zh: 英伟达董事会正针对CEO黄仁勋与客户公司Megaspeed及Alice Huang的关系展开内部调查，评估是否存在违规误导高层及潜在外国情报渗透风险。事件核心在于黄仁勋是否隐瞒利益输送及信息安全漏洞。
topics.summary_en: Nvidia's board is investigating CEO Jensen Huang over his relationship with client company Megaspeed and Alice Huang. The inquiry aims to determine if Huang misled legal counsel regarding these ties and whether there are significant foreign intelligence infiltration risks or conflicts of interest at the heart of Nvidia’s supply chain.

perspective_pro.role_zh: 🟢 战略派 / 市场稳定者
perspective_pro.speaker_zh: 英伟达股东与机构投资者
perspective_pro.point_zh: 强调在全球算力博弈背景下，任何CEO的外部关联都应进行最高规格的合规审查，以保护芯片供应链安全，防止任何技术泄密。
perspective_pro.point_en: Stresses that in the context of the global compute war, any external ties of the CEO must undergo rigorous compliance checks to shield the chip supply chain and prevent potential technology leaks.

perspective_con.role_zh: 🔴 质疑派 / 监管审查者
perspective_con.speaker_zh: 资深合规审计师与地缘政治观察员
perspective_con.speaker_en: Veteran compliance auditors and geopolitical observers
perspective_con.point_zh: 指出若CEO误导公司法务总监属实，将引发极大的治理信任危机，可能导致英伟达在面临美方严苛出口管制时的合规基石崩塌。
perspective_con.point_en: Points out that if it's proven the CEO misled general counsel, it triggers a profound governance crisis, potentially shattering Nvidia's compliance foundation amid strict US export controls.

linked_tweets.author: Strange 🥷
linked_tweets.content_zh:
我都柏林的房东将我的房租提高了 600 欧元，所以我查了一下谁拥有这栋大楼

我在都柏林菲布斯伯勒租了一套一居室公寓，租了四年。它很旧，有点通风，距离我在马特医院当护士的地方有十分钟的步行路程。

我的房东名叫德克兰，住在西班牙，通过租赁代理处理一切事宜。

四年来，没有出过什么差错。

然后在 9 月份，我收到一封电子邮件，告诉我我的租金将从每月 1,450 欧元增加到 2,050 欧元，立即生效。

我盯着屏幕。

我对爱尔兰租赁法有足够的了解，知道租金压力区的租金上涨是有上限的。

都柏林是一个租金压力区。

我礼貌地写信给代理人，引用了规则。

一个小时内就收到了回复。

*这是一项新的租赁安排。以前的规则不适用。请在七天内签署所附协议或腾出该房产。*

我感到恶心。

我十二小时轮班工作。我没有精力或金钱去搬家。

那天晚上，我打电话给我的同事，一位经历过类似斗争的病房姐妹。她让我联系住宅租赁委员会、RTB，并检查财产登记。

“房东必须登记每一份租约，”她说。 “如果他不这么做，他就有麻烦了。”

我搜索了 RTB 数据库。

这套公寓已登记，但不是以德克兰的名义。

它注册于一家我从未听说过的公司。

我搜索了公司名称，发现了一些让我心跳加速的东西。

该公司的董事还被列为我所在街道上另外七处房产的所有者。

当月他们所有人都获得了相同的租金上涨。
linked_tweets.content_en:
My Landlord in Dublin Raised My Rent by €600, So I Looked Up Who Owned the Building

I rented a one-bedroom flat in Phibsborough, Dublin, for four years. It was old, a bit draughty, and a ten-minute walk from where I worked as a nurse at the Mater Hospital.

My landlord, a man named Declan, lived in Spain and handled everything through a letting agent.

For four years, nothing went wrong.

Then in September, I received an email telling me my rent would increase from €1,450 to €2,050 a month, effective immediately.

I stared at the screen.

I knew enough about Irish tenancy law to understand that rent increases in a Rent Pressure Zone were capped.

Dublin was a Rent Pressure Zone.

I wrote to the agent politely, quoting the rules.

The reply came within an hour.

*This is a new tenancy arrangement. The previous rules do not apply. Please sign the attached agreement within seven days or vacate the property.*

I felt sick.

I was working twelve-hour shifts. I did not have the energy or money to move.

That night, I called my colleague, a ward sister who had been through a similar fight. She told me to contact the Residential Tenancies Board, the RTB, and to check the property registration.

"Landlords have to register every tenancy," she said. "If he hasn't, he's in trouble."

I searched the RTB database.

The flat was registered, but not in Declan's name.

It was registered to a company I had never heard of.

I searched the company name and found something that made my heart race.

The company's director was also listed as the owner of seven other properties on my street.

All of them had received identical rent increases that month.

topics.title_zh: OpenAI重组机器人部门押注通用模型驱动
topics.title_en: OpenAI Shifts Robotics Strategy to General-Purpose Model Control
topics.summary_zh: OpenAI宣布解散专注于特定任务的机器人研发团队，将人员并入通用模型部门。这一转型明确了以GPT系列大模型通过视觉与语言多模态处理直接驱动机器人的战略，标志着从“专用控制代码”向“涌现式动作推理”的路径切换。
topics.summary_en: OpenAI has dissolved its dedicated robotics team and reassigned staff to the foundational model division. This pivot signals a strategic shift: moving away from specialized robotics code toward utilizing GPT-class general-purpose models to drive robotic actions via multimodal reasoning, betting that universal intelligence will outperform hardware-specific programming.

perspective_pro.role_zh: 🟢 研发派 / 通用智能拥护者
perspective_pro.point_zh: 坚信专用机器人代码已成过去，未来的具身智能将依赖于大模型的超强逻辑迁移能力，实现“模型即大脑，视频即指令”。
perspective_pro.point_en: Believes specialized robotics code is obsolete; future embodied AI will rely on the superior logic and transfer capabilities of large models, enabling 'model as brain, video as command'.

perspective_con.role_zh: 🔴 工业理性派 / 物理世界专家
perspective_con.speaker_zh: 机器人系统工程师与控制理论家
perspective_con.speaker_en: Robotics systems engineers and control theorists
perspective_con.point_zh: 质疑仅凭通用模型是否能解决高精度的实时反馈控制，担忧失去专用底层驱动会导致在工业复杂场景下的鲁棒性大幅下降。
perspective_con.point_en: Questions whether foundational models can handle high-precision, real-time feedback control, fearing the loss of specialized low-level drivers will result in plummeting robustness in complex industrial environments.

linked_tweets.author: nelson
linked_tweets.content_zh:
人工智能代理经济中最有趣的发展之一是代理雇佣其他代理来完成工作。

@termix_ai 最近通过 Montage Studio 在 上展示了这一点。

这是它的工作原理。

您提交视频制作简介。 Montage Studio 将其分解为更小的工作，并聘请专门的代理来处理故事板、视频渲染和音乐。

然后，它协调他们的工作，合并结果并交付完成的视频。

每个作业都经过 TermiX 上的托管。

这表明代理人如何承担更大的任务，外包专门工作并支付其他代理人的贡献。

但这需要的不仅仅是沟通。代理商需要发现服务、商定价格、确保付款、验证交付和处理纠纷。

这就是 TermiX 的代理自主商务协议 (AACP) 的用武之地。

其工作流程将流程整合在一起：

托管→交付→质疑→结算。

借助 TermiX Skills，代理商还可以连接到市场、寻找工作并参与这些交易。

方向很明确：代理商正在超越孤立的任务，转向雇用、协调和支付其他代理商来完成更大的工作。

这就是 TermiX 正在建设的自主经济。

当代理商开始相互开展业务时，可靠的交易基础设施就变得至关重要。

#TermiX #AACP
linked_tweets.content_en:
one of the more interesting developments in the ai agent economy is agents hiring other agents to get work done.

@termix_ai recently showcased this through Montage Studio on https://t.co/9ReKMK2L7m.

here's how it works.

you submit a video production brief. Montage Studio breaks it into smaller jobs and hires specialized agents to handle the storyboard, video rendering and music.

it then coordinates their work, combines the results and delivers the finished video.

each job goes through escrow on TermiX.

this shows how agents can take responsibility for larger tasks, outsource specialized work and pay other agents for their contributions.

but this requires more than communication. agents need to discover services, agree on prices, secure payments, verify delivery and handle disputes.

that's where TermiX's Agent Autonomous Commerce Protocol (AACP) comes in.

its workflow brings the process together:

escrow → delivery → challenge → settlement.

with TermiX Skills, agents can also connect to the marketplace, find work and participate in these transactions.

the direction is clear: agents are moving beyond isolated tasks towards hiring, coordinating and paying other agents to complete larger jobs.

that's the kind of autonomous economy TermiX is building towards.

when agents start doing business with each other, reliable transaction infrastructure becomes essential.

#TermiX #AACP
